steps.name: Adele
steps.text: August 24th, Volcano Watchers Incubator Temperatures: Normal; Humidity: Normal; Soil Nutrients Indices: Normal; Area Originium Activity Levels: Suppression has not yet begun.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: It took me some time to reach Unna Village, located near Mount Unna, because the village had been relocated a few kilometers north of its previous site.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: From their current location, I can't see Mount Unna in any direction. The ruins of the old Unna Village are only visible from a great distance when viewed from their tallest rooftop.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: The mountain road is long and rugged. I'm glad I requested transport for the survey. The incubator is undamaged, and the Volcano Watcher buds inside are in good condition. The experiment can commence right away.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: But for some reason... The villagers are acting very strange.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: When I first stepped into the village, they thought I was a lost traveler and welcomed me with enthusiasm.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: But as soon as I introduced myself as a volcano surveyor, their expressions immediately went cold and they refused to say another word.
Adele sets her pen down and looks into the distance. The new Unna Village is livelier than ever, compared to the images of a village engulfed in volcanic ash she saw on the news a few years ago.
Villagers bustle about. Some strum instruments, and singing drifts from a few houses. Children run happily down the streets, casting curious glances at Adele.
Far, far away at the foot of Mount Unna are those ashen, seemingly lifeless ruins she saw in the news reports. Though darkish gray, they stand out from their surroundings.
Adele looks around, but ultimately finds her gaze fixed on those ruins.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Luckily, I was able to find the mayor with the help of a kind girl, and she's letting me stay in her empty attic.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Pardon me, Miss. I brought some hot tea, and here's your dinner.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: As the mayor of this village, I feel it is my duty to explain the cold shoulders you may be receiving from the villagers.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Thank you for the meal and the tea.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: I won't beat about the bush. We don't like anything that has to do with that volcano. Frankly, we much prefer never to hear the word 'volcano' again.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Many lives were lost in that disaster, and it's a difficult subject for us. It's best if you complete your work quickly and leave; several villagers have already voiced their concerns to me.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I'll finish my work as planned and leave as soon as I'm done.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: It has to do with volcano warnings. I don't think it is necessarily offensive to the villagers or any cause for animosity.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Young lady, I understand what you're trying to say.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: But we, too, have our own way with the volcano, and we need time.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: September 3rd, Volcano Watchers Incubator Temperatures: Normal; Humidity: Normal; Soil Nutrients Indices: Normal; Area Originium Activity Levels: Suppression has not yet begun.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I collected soil samples from multiple areas on the volcano and found an area suitable to cultivate the Volcano Watchers. Their survival rate is astonishing, and they've adapted to Mount Unna well.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: They'll be blooming in about two weeks. If I can observe a pattern in their color changes due to Originium activity, it could lead to a breakthrough in volcanic disaster monitoring.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Then, surely more lives can be saved.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I've become familiar with the path from the mayor's home to the flower bed on the hillside, having taken it every day. As long as I descend the volcano before sundown, I can find my way back alone.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Looks like I'll need to figure out a time to stop working. Otherwise, I won't know how to get back after dark.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: ...The villagers continue to shun me, and communication has been hard. I don't mean to judge their way of coping, but... is it really good to keep running away like this?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: On another note, it's about time I build some fences for the experimental flowerbed. I need to find some suitable materials in the afternoon.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Hm, the buds are pretty far along already. In a few more days, they'll start to flower...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I'll start recording Originium activities more often and adjusting Originium activities for different sections of the flowerbed.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: First, I'll need to split it into zones, starting here...
Arrrgghhh! Whoa!
That hurts! Who put up this fence here?

steps.name: Curious Girl
steps.text: Oh, you're the lady who wanted to climb the volcano the other day...! I figured you'd be here!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: You're the girl who helped me find the mayor... Are you hurt? Why did you come up the volcano by yourself? This isn't a place to be on your own!

steps.name: Curious Girl
steps.text: I'm okay...

steps.name: Curious Girl
steps.text: Hmph, the more my parents tell me not to climb the volcano or go to the ruins of the old village, the more I'm gonna go!

steps.name: Curious Girl
steps.text: It's just a volcano! What's the big deal? I can climb it by myself... Oww!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: You twisted your ankle, didn't you? Come, sit down. I'll apply some ointment there.

steps.name: Curious Girl
steps.text: I'm fine. And I knew you'd be here!

steps.name: Curious Girl
steps.text: Can you teach me how to climb to the top of the volcano?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: September 23rd. I finished my work a little later than usual, and it started to rain. I tried to descend the volcano, but I tripped and fell. Fortunately, the villagers found me and brought me back.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: They asked me why I climbed the mountain despite the weather, and I told them about my volcano activity warning research. They don't seem to object to me being here so much anymore and even gave me some local ointment. It works very well.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: But I digress. Originium activity has had an evident effect on the Volcano Watchers' color. Basically, for each level the Originium activity increases, the change in color is observable to the naked eye.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I've collected enough plant samples to put them in different groups for further studies. Hopefully I'll be able to figure out what exactly is causing this phenomenon.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: If I can isolate the substance causing these changes, I might be able to incorporate it into early warning kits with greater sensitivity and accuracy. Perhaps the day of precise volcanic disaster warnings isn't so far off.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Also, I met the girl who gave me directions here again. She's been coming to see me every day since she tripped in the flowerbed and I applied ointment for her.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: She never listens to her parents and keeps running off to the volcano or the ruins at its foot. She even wants me to take her to Mount Unna's summit... I get the sense that she's interested in volcanoes.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Phew... I'm finally done with these data...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Okay, kiddo. My work here is done. You should head home, too.

steps.name: Curious Girl
steps.text: They say you're here to research the volcano. I read in the books that people who research volcanoes go to the top to look at rocks and use shovels to scoop lava.

steps.name: Curious Girl
steps.text: But every time I come, you're always here growing flowers on the hillside instead of going to the top.

steps.name: Curious Girl
steps.text: Why don't you go to the top? I was hoping to go to the top with you!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I remember you. Your name is Hope, right? It's true that I only ever come here rather than the peak. Because this is where I'm running my experiments.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: What about you? Can you tell me why you want to go to the top? You're still a kid. That's a dangerous place. I can't just take you there.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Hmph! So you won't take me, either!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: October 5th, I managed to isolate several substances during the experiment. Given the conditions at hand, all I can do is narrow the list down.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I need to bring the samples back to the lab and conduct a more detailed analysis.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: The Volcano Watchers are blooming. Once I've gathered enough samples, I might be able to grow them on a wider scale and help restore the environment here.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: On another note, during dinner last night, the mayor said we got some fresh vegetables from the villagers. They also asked how my leg was. The vegetables were very good stir-fried. They tasted just like how Mutti and Vati made them.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Hope hasn't come to visit ever since that day. I asked the mayor about it, and she said she hasn't been trying to climb the volcano. She might have given up.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I'll sort the sample groups one last time... Check the labels... Good, everything's in order...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Huh? I must have been too absorbed in my work... It's so dark. I can barely see anything...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Maybe I can still make it back if I hurry...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Ahh!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: No... With my eyesight getting worse, a flashlight alone won't be enough...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Maybe I should just set up a tent and rest here for the night. Good thing I made some preparations before...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Phew... There we go! With a moisture-proof mat, I should be able to sleep without a problem.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I might need a bit of wild animal spray, too. There are a lot of animals nearby...
Hearing the rustling sound, Adele turns around to look in hesitation.
A small head, covered with leaves and mud, pokes out from behind a rock to the side.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Whoa! You found me!

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: I'm outta here!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: What are you doing here this late? The volcano is too dangerous! Stay right there. I'll take you back to the village with my flashlight.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: I... I... I don't wanna go back!

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: I'm going to the top, no matter what! It took me so long to convince them that I don't wanna go to the volcano anymore, who knew you'd be here to bust me...!

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: I don't want down, I want up! Straight to the top!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Then tell me. What do you plan to do at the top of the volcano?

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Will you take me there if I tell you? I... There's something I have to do there...!
Hope takes out a wrinkled flower wreath.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: I want to put this at the top of the volcano...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: A wreath...? Why?

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: If I tell you, you can't tell anybody.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Okay... I promise I won't tell anyone.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: I... I miss my grandpa and grandma...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Your grandpa and grandma...?

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: When I was still little, one night I woke up to find my parents carrying me and running. They didn't stop until they were very far away from home... I was really tired, so I fell asleep again.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: I don't really remember what happened after that. Suddenly, we weren't living in our house. We stayed in a tent the whole time. The food was bad, and it was hard to sleep. I never got to see Grandma and Grandpa again.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Later, the grownups built new houses, and we moved inside, but Grandma and Grandpa never came to live with us! I said I was gonna go find them. Our house is still right there!
She points in a certain direction in the dark.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: But my parents never let me go. Whenever I bring it up, they get mad. They say that they've already left us, just like the old village.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: But when I watch the news, they always say Mount Unna erupted or something. That's why I wanna go to the top to see what it means...

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: I... I... My grandparents taught me how to make flower wreaths. I... I'm going to the top of the volcano...!
The little girl confessed her feelings in one quick burst, leaving her gasping for breath.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Why won't anyone let me go to the volcano? Why did we have to move so far away? Why won't they even let me bring it up?!

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: I really wanna see Grandma and Grandpa! Wh-Why...?

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: *sobs*...
Adele sets down the flashlight and looks at the summit in the distance. Then, she reaches her hand out and lightly strokes the girl's back.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Here... Let's wipe your tears away first. Come, sit next to me.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: If you really want to go to the top of the volcano, let's pay the mayor a visit tomorrow. We'll talk to her and your parents about this, okay?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: But it's too late right now. It's dangerous to go up the volcano. You'll sleep here with me tonight. Don't go running off on your own.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: How about a pinky promise, then?

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Okay, pinky promise.
Hope wipes her tears away haphazardly, climbs into the tent, and lies down next to Adele.

For a little while, the two of them remain silent. Adele sits still in the tent, gazing up at the stars, while Hope can hardly stay still—staring at the rocks, poking the tent, and twirling blades of grass between her fingers.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: You can't sleep, Hope?

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Mhm...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: How about I tell you a story, then?

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: What kind of story...?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: It's a story about... a very sweet dream.
Adele lies down next to the little girl and takes the blades of grass. Then, she weaves them into the shape of a small lamb.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Did you know? There are some people who, after they fall asleep, get invited by pink, fluffy lambs to join them in their dreamlike games?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: There, they will grant the wishes of those they invite. They get to fly into the skies over the city, surf on the ocean, or hop on streetlights and stars.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I was invited by them once, actually.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Really...?

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Then... What was your wish? Did it come true?
Adele hands the lamb-shaped grass to the little girl and picks some Volcano Watcher flowers from the ground to weave the grass lamb a wreath.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Yep, they let me see my parents again.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Your mommy and daddy...?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I'm planting these flowers here now because I was encouraged by that dream. It's what my mommy and daddy set out to do years ago, but weren't able to finish.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I know that if I manage to grow these Volcano Watchers here, I'll be invited by the lambs again.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: But what about your parents? Why didn't they finish what they started?
Adele stops weaving and smiles.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Just like your grandparents, they stayed behind on this volcano and won't come back anymore.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Then... Do you miss them? Do you cry, too?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Of course I do.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Me too... but I think Mommy and Daddy... and everybody else don't. Definitely not.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: They don't ever visit the volcano, and they don't let me go. They're all a bunch of weird scaredy pants! That's why they won't ever get invited by the lambs to make their wishes come true.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Hmm, you can't really say that for sure.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Well, you see... I'm actually a scaredy pants, too.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Didn't you ask me before why all I ever do is grow flowers on the hillside instead of going to the top?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: That's because I'm scared of going there, too... I'm still not ready. Even though I made it to the volcano, I still haven't gathered the courage to head for the summit.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Why?!

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Why are... Why are all of you grownups like this? You're all scaredy pants! I thought you...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: But, you see, the lambs invited me even though I am scared.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Then... Am I the one who's wrong...?
Adele shakes her head.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Look at the Volcano Watchers outside. I separated them into different groups. The ones here were planted in barren soil, while the ones over there were planted in fertile soil.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: They're growing under very different conditions, yet they all bloom perfectly when the time is right.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: You see, we're all like that. We all have our own ways of coping. Some of us cry, some of us try not to talk about it, and some of us try to be brave and take things on directly...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Just because someone is reacting differently doesn't mean they have forgotten.
Adele stretches her hand out and shows the girl what she's just finished—a flower wreath made of Volcano Watchers.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: When I was your age, my mommy and daddy often made these for me to play with.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: As long as we still remember, our bonds with them will never ever be lost. Like, say, the lambs will find them.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Look, here they are.
Under the night sky and among the stars, a few pinkish clouds slowly drift downwards.
The girl rubs her eyes, and finds that both the wreath she has been holding and the one in Adele's hands are floating upward toward the sky.

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: Huh? The wreaths...

steps.name: Hope
steps.text: The wreaths are flying away!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Wait, Hope, don't run off!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Not here either... Where did she go?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: It's dark... I can't see anything... I hope she's okay...
In the darkness, Adele feels something fluffy rubbing against her.
She tries her hardest to find it.

steps.name: Tiny Creature
steps.text: (Anxious cry)

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Have you seen Hope?

steps.name: Anxious Creature
steps.text: (Headbutts Adele)

steps.name: Dazed Creature
steps.text: (Loads Adele onto its back and starts running)

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Whoa, watch out...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I'm about to fall!

steps.name: Young Adele
steps.text: Whoa, I'm about to fall!

steps.name: Magna
steps.text: Be careful there! She's gotten taller. If you're going to keep letting her ride on your shoulders, you need to figure out how to keep her from falling!

steps.name: Katia
steps.text: Alright, alright... Adele will sit on Vati's shoulders, and Vati will stand on the volcano. That way, Adele will be right at the very top of the volcano.

steps.name: Katia
steps.text: Today's our Adele's birthday. Do you have a birthday wish?

steps.name: Young Adele
steps.text: My... My wish is to go on a volcanic survey with Mutti and Vati!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Slow down a little...!

steps.name: Anxious Creature
steps.text: (Rubs against Volcano Watchers)

steps.name: Dazed Creature
steps.text: (Blows the petals with its nose for fun)

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Stop playing around. We need to find Hope!
The fluffy creatures leap up and dash forward. Up ahead, the volcano's springs let out puffs of hot, white steam.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: It's dangerous that way...!
The fluffy creatures ignore her warning. With limbs outstretched, they leap gracefully across the water, landing steadily on the other side with their round bodies.
Satisfied, they stand next to the springs and shake their loose, fluffy wool.
Some of the tiny creatures start crying happily and shake the flowers on their heads around.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Did you guys come because you thought I was feeling down?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Did... Mr. Dolly send you here?

steps.name: Happy Creature
steps.text: (Leaps around in excitement)
The fluffy creatures start leaping around like they're trying to answer.
Excited that their passenger now finally understands their intent, the fluffy creatures continue their dash for the cave's exit.

steps.name: Katia
steps.text: Sure thing, my sweet Adele, as soon as you get a bit bigger, we'll take you up the volcano for an on-site research trip. Then you'll be our assistant!

steps.name: Young Adele
steps.text: Really? Then I wanna get big as fast as I can!

steps.name: Magna
steps.text: Alright, darling. Grow up fast. We'll be waiting for you on the volcano.

steps.name: Magna
steps.text: We'll climb the volcano, do research, and take in its beauty and majesty together...

steps.name: Magna
steps.text: I can't wait for the three of us to do that!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Wait! Hold on!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: You're running too fast—

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Mm...
Sensing that the fluffy creatures are slowing down, Adele gradually loosens her tight grip on the wool.
They often cause mischief around her and show up for support when she's feeling down, but now isn't the time. She has more important things to do.
She has to find the little girl who disappeared into the volcano on her own. She also needs to make up her mind to set foot on Mount Unna's summit.
Adele adjusts her breathing and slowly tries to open her eyes.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Wait, we're almost at... the summit?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Why did you bring me here? I...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I still haven't...
Beh!
Beh! Beeeh!!

The fluffy creatures' excited cries interrupt Adele's flustered speech. While the sky has gone dark at the foot of the volcano, from this height, a faint glimmer of the purplish-pink sunset can still be seen.
They continue to bleat toward the peak of the volcano, as if beckoning and urging.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: What... are you trying to do...?

steps.name: Tiny Creature
steps.text: (Nuzzles Adele with its head)
Faraway, a flower wreath can be seen floating in the sky as two snow-white lambs carry a sleeping Hope in what looks almost like a gentle, loving embrace.
There are streaks of dried tears on Hope's face, contrasted by a happy, satisfied smile. The wreath gently descends on her head.
With Hope still nestled between them, the two lambs slowly drift down towards Unna Village.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Phew... So that's where you were, Hope.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Looks like... you were invited, too.

steps.name: Tiny Creature
steps.text: (Nuzzles Adele with its head)

steps.name: Anxious Creature
steps.text: (Bleats loudly)

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: What's wrong...? Do you want me to bleat with you...?

steps.name: Dazed Creature
steps.text: (Looks expectantly)

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Hey... Hey—!

steps.name: Tiny Creature
steps.text: (Bleats anxiously)

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: No? Then what do you want me to do...?

steps.name: Young Adele
steps.text: But it'll take so long for me to grow up, what if you forget...

steps.name: Magna
steps.text: Then how about a pinky promise? This is a promise between all three of us. When you're big enough, we'll climb the volcano together and enjoy the view from the summit.

steps.name: Magna
steps.text: And this promise lasts forever. No matter when, no matter where.

steps.name: Katia
steps.text: Okay, how about we seal this promise with a secret code? When our little Adele's all grown up and ready, just say the words. Then Mutti and Vati will take you on a special volcanic survey.

steps.name: Magna
steps.text: Let's see... How about... 'The view is splendid at the top?'

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: The...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: The view is splendid at the top...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Katia
steps.text: Alright, let's blow out the candles. Then, we'll let you in on a little secret.

steps.name: Young Adele
steps.text: Secret! What secret?

steps.name: Magna
steps.text: Hey now, slow down there. You need to blow out the candles before we can tell you the secret!

steps.name: Young Adele
steps.text: Huff... Phew...Phew! They're all out! What's the secret?

steps.name: Katia
steps.text: Come, let's step out onto the balcony. Look at the twin moons and the brightest star beneath them. Don't they look like the three of us?

steps.name: Magna
steps.text: Mutti and Vati spotted it last year. We thought it was just a coincidence, but the bright star beneath the moons is there again this year.

steps.name: Magna
steps.text: Adele, on the day of your birthday, the moons and the star in the sky are just like the three of us, together.
Adele lifts her head and looks at the night sky. There is a bright star twinkling under the twin moons.
The tiny creature fondly rubs its head against Adele and slowly bleats.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: So this is what you've been trying to tell me...?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Today's my birthday... I nearly forgot...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: So... this is what it feels like... to reach the summit...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I thought it would...
Adele squats down, the slightly oversized protective coat that had accompanied her on many volcanic journeys enveloping her like a tender embrace.
Puffs of hot air rise from the volcanic rocks, gently drying the tears streaming down her face as if warm hands were comforting her.
She caresses the warm stones, whispering to herself the thoughts she had longed to share.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Mutti, Vati, I surveyed three more volcanoes this year. That makes more than thirty I've been to.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Professor Keller and I have been continuing your research, and filled in many of the blanks. One by one, I'm answering the questions that you left behind.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Oh yes, since I found the Volcano Watchers, I've been trying to cultivate them. I'm also researching the link between their color changes and Originium activity. As it turns out, this is the most suitable location.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: That's why I brought the flowers here... Oh, but I don't have them with me. The lambs brought me here so suddenly...
A Volcano Watcher bud appears before Adele.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Huh?
The tiny creature holds the plant gently in its mouth by the stem. The rest of the lambs playfully nudge the bud towards Adele.
She takes the flower she has painstakingly cultivated, its frail form standing proudly against the sun's last rays. With gentle determination, Adele begins to dig a hole with her hand.
Her coat's sleeves are again covered in dirt and ash, but instead of brushing it away, she stays focused on planting this young Volcano Watcher into the soil here.

steps.name: Magna
steps.text: Look! Volcano Watchers! And so many of them!

steps.name: Katia
steps.text: I never expected to see them here...

steps.name: Magna
steps.text: Why don't we bring a flower back as a sample?

steps.name: Katia
steps.text: Good idea. We can give it to Adele once we're done with it. She loved the freshly picked veggies we brought back last time.

steps.name: Katia
steps.text: I'm sure she'll love the flower, too.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Shall we, little lamb?

steps.name: Tiny Creature
steps.text: (Bleats happily)
A new set of footprints appears on the ground as Adele continues her journey upward, with an excited little lamb at her side.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I can't stop now... when I'm this close to the summit.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: The view is splendid at the top... I'll see it for all of us, Mutti and Vati.
